title: Measured expensive derived collections are recomputed during React renders
lesson: Use useMemo for a measured expensive pure derivation whose dependencies change less often than the component renders. Do not apply memoization without a performance reason.

title: Fresh object props defeat memoized React children
lesson: Keep props passed to a measured memoized child referentially stable when their inputs are unchanged.

title: React effects leave subscriptions active after lifecycle changes
lesson: Return cleanup for subscriptions, timers, listeners, and in-flight work established by an effect.

title: React list items use unstable positional keys
lesson: Use a stable identity from the data for list keys so insertions and reordering preserve component state correctly.

title: React effects duplicate state that can be derived during render
lesson: Calculate synchronous derived values during render instead of storing and synchronizing redundant state in an effect.

title: Rendering repeatedly interleaves layout reads and writes
lesson: Batch DOM reads and writes so a loop does not force synchronous layout for every item.

title: Rarely used heavy UI code is loaded on the initial route
lesson: Split genuinely deferred features at a stable route or interaction boundary instead of adding them to the initial bundle.

title: Large collections render every row without a bound
lesson: Paginate or virtualize collections that can grow beyond the measured rendering budget.

title: Component colors bypass semantic design tokens
lesson: Reference role-based design tokens from components and add a semantic token when the role is missing.

title: Component spacing bypasses the design-system scale
lesson: Use the repository spacing scale rather than introducing an isolated literal dimension in a component.

title: User-facing copy bypasses the localization catalog
lesson: Store translatable user-facing text in the message catalog and reference its stable key from UI code.

title: A user input has no programmatic label
lesson: Associate every user input with a visible label or equivalent accessible name that describes the expected value.

title: A clickable generic element replaces a semantic control
lesson: Use the native interactive element whose keyboard behavior, role, and state match the action.

title: Custom styles remove the visible keyboard focus indicator
lesson: Preserve a visible, sufficiently distinguishable focus indicator for every keyboard-operable control.

title: Status is communicated by color alone
lesson: Provide text, iconography with an accessible name, or another non-color cue for status and errors.

title: Nonessential animation ignores reduced-motion preferences
lesson: Disable or reduce nonessential motion when the user requests reduced motion.

title: Untrusted values are interpolated into a SQL statement
lesson: Use parameterized queries and keep untrusted values separate from SQL syntax.

title: Dynamic process arguments are interpolated into a shell command
lesson: Invoke the program without a shell and pass each dynamic value as a separate argument.

title: A database query runs once for every item in a collection
lesson: Load related data in a bounded query plan instead of issuing one query per row.

title: A multi-step invariant is updated outside one transaction
lesson: Commit dependent state changes atomically so partial failure cannot expose an invalid intermediate state.

title: A retried write can apply the same business operation twice
lesson: Give retryable writes an idempotency identity and return the original outcome for a repeated operation.

title: An API collection endpoint accepts an unbounded result size
lesson: Enforce a server-side page-size ceiling and use a stable continuation mechanism.

title: A presentation change silently changes an existing API field
lesson: Preserve the established field meaning and add a new field for new semantics.

title: Offset-aware timestamps are compared with a naive current time
lesson: Normalize service timestamps and the current time to explicit compatible time zones before comparison.

title: Data access is keyed without the tenant authorization boundary
lesson: Include the authenticated tenant or organization boundary in lookup, cache, and mutation authorization.

title: Logs include credentials, tokens, or sensitive personal data
lesson: Log stable nonsecret identifiers and redact sensitive values before they reach structured logging.

title: A server fetches an untrusted URL without an outbound policy
lesson: Validate the destination against the allowed scheme and host policy and block private or metadata networks.

title: An untrusted path escapes the intended storage root
lesson: Resolve the final path and verify it remains inside the allowed root before filesystem access.

title: A security token uses a predictable random generator
lesson: Use the platform cryptographic random generator for tokens, reset links, nonces, and credentials.

title: An expensive or sensitive endpoint has no abuse bound
lesson: Apply an identity-aware rate or cost limit with an explicit overload response.

title: Credentialed cross-origin access trusts an unrestricted origin
lesson: Allow only reviewed origins for credentialed requests and vary responses by the validated origin.

title: Personal data is retained without a deletion boundary
lesson: Define and enforce a retention period tied to the documented purpose and deletion workflow.

title: Retries run immediately without bounded exponential backoff and jitter
lesson: Retry only transient failures with a maximum attempt or time budget, exponential backoff, and jitter.

title: A remote dependency call has no deadline
lesson: Set an end-to-end deadline based on the caller budget and propagate cancellation to the dependency.

title: Multiple service layers independently retry the same operation
lesson: Choose one retry layer and preserve a shared attempt budget so retries do not multiply downstream load.

title: Liveness and readiness probes test the same dependency condition
lesson: Use readiness to remove traffic during recoverable dependency failure and liveness only for unrecoverable process failure.

title: A deployment uses a mutable container image tag
lesson: Pin production images to an immutable version or digest so rollout and rollback resolve the same artifact.

title: A production workload has no CPU or memory requests and limits
lesson: Declare measured resource requests and protective limits so scheduling and overload behavior are explicit.

title: An infrastructure policy grants wildcard actions or resources
lesson: Grant only the reviewed actions on the narrowest practical resources and conditions.

title: A deployment removes a schema contract before all readers migrate
lesson: Use an expand, migrate, and contract sequence that remains compatible throughout rolling deployment.

title: Reprocessing an input duplicates data-pipeline output
lesson: Give each source record a stable identity and make retries or backfills upsert the same logical output.

title: A pipeline accepts records without validating the expected schema
lesson: Validate required fields, types, and evolution rules at the ingestion boundary before transformation.

title: Model preprocessing learns from evaluation data
lesson: Split evaluation data before fitting preprocessing, feature selection, or model parameters.

title: A reported experiment cannot reproduce its random state
lesson: Record and control every relevant source of randomness together with data and environment versions.

title: Missing values are silently collapsed into a valid business value
lesson: Preserve missingness explicitly until a documented domain rule performs imputation or rejection.

title: A scientific calculation combines values with incompatible units
lesson: Represent or validate units at the calculation boundary and convert to one documented unit before arithmetic.

title: A numerical decision relies on exact floating-point equality
lesson: Compare floating-point results with a domain-appropriate relative and absolute tolerance.

title: Metrics aggregate precomputed averages without their weights
lesson: Aggregate the underlying numerator and denominator or carry the population weight with every partial metric.

title: Blocking I/O runs on the interactive client main thread
lesson: Move blocking storage and network work off the main thread and publish the result through the lifecycle-aware UI boundary.

title: Asynchronous client work survives the owning screen lifecycle
lesson: Cancel or detach asynchronous work when its owning lifecycle ends and ignore stale completion.

title: An older asynchronous response overwrites newer state
lesson: Associate responses with the active request generation and discard completion from superseded work.

title: Concurrent workers mutate shared state without one ownership rule
lesson: Use message passing, immutability, or a correctly scoped synchronization primitive around shared mutation.

title: A file, stream, or connection is not closed on every exit path
lesson: Bind resource lifetime to a deterministic cleanup construct that runs on success, error, and cancellation.

title: A durable file is overwritten in place
lesson: Write and sync a temporary file in the destination directory, then atomically replace the target.

title: Code acquires shared locks in inconsistent order
lesson: Define one lock ordering and acquire multiple locks in that order on every path.

title: A producer can grow an in-memory work queue without bound
lesson: Use a bounded queue and an explicit wait, reject, or shed policy when consumers are saturated.

title: A test waits with a fixed sleep for an asynchronous condition
lesson: Wait for the observable condition with a bounded deadline instead of guessing a wall-clock delay.

title: A test depends on mutable state left by another test
lesson: Give every test isolated state and make execution order irrelevant.

title: Published documentation contains an executable example that is not verified
lesson: Run documentation examples in CI or generate them from tested source so commands and APIs stay valid.

title: A runbook performs destructive recovery without a backup or preview gate
lesson: Require target verification, a recoverable backup or snapshot, and a preview before destructive recovery steps.

title: A release procedure has no measurable rollback trigger
lesson: Define monitored success criteria, a bounded observation window, and an executable rollback path before rollout.

title: Generated reference documentation is edited independently of its source
lesson: Regenerate reference artifacts from the canonical source and fail CI when committed output drifts.

title: Analytics events include raw sensitive user values
lesson: Emit reviewed event fields with pseudonymous identifiers and exclude free-form or sensitive payloads.

title: An experiment decision uses a primary metric without safety guardrails
lesson: Predefine data-quality and harm guardrails, decision thresholds, and a stopping rule before reading experiment results.
